name: Men Sleep With Men
overview: Scripture clearly condemns the practice of men lying with men as an abomination, as stated in Leviticus 18:22 and 20:13, with severe consequences prescribed. The narrative in Genesis 19:1 illustrates the sinful behavior of Sodom, which serves as a warning against such actions. Romans 1:26 explains that turning away from God's design leads to unnatural affections, while Luke 17:34 acknowledges the reality of men sharing a bed, though it does not condone the practice. Ultimately, Romans 10:13 offers hope through salvation for all who call upon the Lord, emphasizing the possibility of redemption despite sin.
